title: Head pressure building?
caption: Head pressure building? Today feels a bit wobbly and a little off, and focus may come and go like small waves. Try slow breathing and a soft jaw, lower light and sound, and take short breaks to pace your day.
snapshot: The day leans unsettled rather than calm. The magnetic field is tilted south, which can stir things a bit. Solar wind runs at a normal clip. One small flare popped, with no CMEs reported.
affects: Head and sinus pressure may feel more noticeable for some. Attention can wander and come back in waves. Sensitive folks may feel a mild hum in the body without a big trigger.
playbook:
- Try slow breathing and a soft jaw
- Dim brightness and lower sound
- Sip water; add a light stretch
- Step outside for a few minutes of light
- Check local pollen and humidity if that fits you

fb.caption: Head pressure creeping in and focus wobbling a bit? Today has that slightly off‑kilter vibe, with attention rolling in like small waves and a low body hum—more like a faint radio catching static than a storm. Why it matters: when the background feels unsettled, your nervous system works a touch harder, so sinus pressure and distractibility can show up without a clear trigger. Pace by dimming screens and sound, softening your jaw, sipping water, and working in short, gentle blocks with breath breaks or a minute of daylight. Noticing that forehead press or the ebb‑and‑flow focus today?
